card.name: Conference and catalogue title endings
card.fires_on: The last word or word piece of a title-like noun phrase, mostly "Conference", also "Catalog(ue)", "Factbook" and "Index". It appears in names of events, books and reference works in web text.

modes.label: Conference in event names
modes.description: The word Conference closing the name of a named meeting.
modes.example: Paul Machin reports on the Copenhagen Climate Change<< Conference>> for GDW.

modes.label: Catalogue or factbook pieces
modes.description: Part of a reference-work title such as Catalogue or Factbook, including the piece before its ending.
modes.example: CIA World Fact<<book>> - This is a summary of all public

modes.label: Foreign or index titles
modes.description: A word piece inside a bibliography title or the word Index in a list title.

card.plain: It fires on the final word of a title, especially the word Conference in the name of a meeting.
